audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer repeatedly calls Aurora's W 'Weightless' — the real ability is Across the Veil per the kit file. Cooldowns field had no digit.
audit.why: Kit: W (Across the Veil) 22/21/20/19/18s — her hop-plus-invisibility escape on a very long cooldown; R (Between Worlds) 140/120/100s; E (The Weirding) 15s rank 1 with a backward hop. Aurora's P (Spirit Abjuration) heals off exorcised spirits — the anti-heal interaction was absent from the page.
audit.corrected: 'Weightless' replaced with Across the Veil everywhere it appears; real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns; P-sustain noted in dontsFull[2].d.

edits.before: - Aurora Across the Veil (Hop): matchup-defining — Her hop + stealth escape — she is killable only while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Abscond (shield-dash) like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Across the Veil is 22s at rank 1 — her hop-plus-invisibility escape; once she hops, she is killable for the next twenty seconds. - Between Worlds runs 140/120/100s, so most all-ins happen without it. - Your Hijack cycles at 80/55/30s — spend it in her W gap.

edits.before: The opening levels are an even, skill-based affair. Aurora's Q (Twofold Hex) trades blow-for-blow with your Chain Lash, and her W (Weightless) dash lets her dodge as often as she gets clipped. Whoever lands their skillshot first wins the exchange, so focus on hitting the far edge of your Q and reading her hop before you commit Abduct.
edits.after: The opening levels are an even, skill-based affair. Whoever lands their skillshot first wins the exchange, so focus on hitting the far edge of your Q and reading her hop before you commit Abduct.

edits.before: It stays a coinflip through 4-5, then swings to you at 6. Neither of you snowballs the trade early — her mobility and root balance your Abduct threat. But once you have Hijack, you can grapple her down before she Weightless-es away and steal an ult to seal it; her escape is on a long cooldown, so time the all-in for when her W is spent.
